description: This file defines the 'RomTree' class, a custom Swing component extending JTree, used for displaying and interacting with ROM data in a GUI. It includes event handling for mouse clicks and key binding actions, integrates with other editor classes, and manages selection and display of table nodes related to ROMs.

classes.name: RomTree
classes.description: A custom Swing JTree component for displaying and managing a tree of ROM-related nodes with GUI interactions.
